name: hud_wave_list_health_and_armour
description: The waves to come give each creep's health at that wave and its armour, scaled as the simulation scales them for this match (playtest halv s1, P8: the list gave checks and counts only, and the numbers came only by clicking a creep on the field: f5508 Thornback 140 hp, armour 4 in wave 4; f9886 the Bristlesow 1125 hp, armour 6; f31585 a Thornback 240 hp in wave 9; f39728 the Crest 2625 hp, armour 4). In High Water alone the rows say those very numbers beside each creep's count ('thornback ×4 · 140 hp · armour 4'), a creep without armour its health only. With a caretaker partner the hollow's two seats double every creep's health (hp_by_seats_pm), and wave 1's first Gourdling on the road has the health its row gave (SimWaves.health_c is the sum its spawn takes). Classic, which leaves armour out, shows none.

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[3] == '4: armored | gourdling ×8 · 42 hp, thornback ×4 · 140 hp · armour 4'
steps.msg: wave 4: the Thornback's 140 hp and armour 4 the persona read off the field, the Gourdlings' health without armour

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[5] == '6: armored | thornback ×3 · 180 hp · armour 4, bristlesow boss · 1125 hp · armour 6 (armored)'
steps.msg: wave 6: the Bristlesow's 1125 hp and armour 6, ahead of the wave

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[8].contains('thornback ×5 · 240 hp · armour 4') and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[11].contains('hollowtide_crest boss · 2625 hp · armour 4 (armored)')
steps.msg: wave 9's Thornbacks at 240 hp, the Crest at 2625

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[0] == '1: swarm | gourdling ×10 · 48 hp' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[3] == '4: armored | gourdling ×8 · 84 hp, thornback ×4 · 280 hp · armour 4'
steps.msg: two seats on the hollow: twice the health, the same armour
the first Gourdling of wave 1 has the health its row gave
classic leaves armour out: health only
